summary: GRI 1: Foundation 2021 introduces the purpose and system of the GRI Standards and explains key concepts for sustainability reporting. It specifies the requirements and reporting principles that organizations must comply with to report in accordance with the GRI Standards.

questions.text: Do you apply all the reporting principles specified in section 4 of GRI 1: Foundation 2021?
questions.hint: Requirement 1-a. The principles cover accuracy, balance, clarity, comparability, completeness, sustainability context, timeliness and verifiability.

disclosures.title: Report the disclosures in GRI 2: General Disclosures 2021

questions.text: Do you report all disclosures in GRI 2: General Disclosures 2021?
questions.hint: Requirement 2-a. Reasons for omission are permitted for all GRI 2 disclosures except 2-1 to 2-5; omissions must be specified in the GRI content index.

questions.text: Have you determined your material topics? If so, describe how.
questions.hint: Requirement 3-a. See section 1 of GRI 3: Material Topics 2021 for guidance on determining material topics.

questions.text: Have you reviewed the applicable GRI Sector Standard(s), determined whether each topic in them is a material topic for your organization, and listed in the GRI content index any topics you determined are not material with an explanation of why?
questions.hint: Requirement 3-b applies only if GRI Sector Standards for your sector(s) are available. State (i) the determination for each Sector Standard topic and (ii) the explanation for each topic not material.

disclosures.title: Report the disclosures in GRI 3: Material Topics 2021

questions.text: Do you report your process of determining material topics using Disclosure 3-1?
questions.hint: Requirement 4-a. Reasons for omission are not permitted for 3-1.

questions.text: Do you report a list of your material topics using Disclosure 3-2?
questions.hint: Requirement 4-b. Reasons for omission are not permitted for 3-2.

questions.text: Do you report how you manage each material topic using Disclosure 3-3?
questions.hint: Requirement 4-c. Reasons for omission are permitted only for 3-3, and must be given in the GRI content index.

disclosures.title: Report disclosures from the GRI Topic Standards for each material topic

questions.text: Do you report disclosures from the GRI Topic Standards for each material topic?
questions.hint: Requirement 5-a. Report only the disclosures relevant to your impacts in relation to each material topic; there is no minimum number of disclosures.

questions.text: For each material topic covered in an applicable GRI Sector Standard, do you either report the Topic Standard disclosures listed for that topic, or provide the 'not applicable' reason for omission with the required explanation in the GRI content index?
questions.hint: Requirement 5-b applies only if GRI Sector Standards for your sector(s) are available.

disclosures.title: Provide reasons for omission for disclosures and requirements that the organization cannot comply with

questions.text: If you cannot comply with a disclosure or a requirement in a disclosure for which reasons for omission are permitted, do you specify in the GRI content index the disclosure or requirement and provide one of the four permitted reasons for omission with the required explanation?
questions.hint: Requirement 6-a (i) specify the disclosure or requirement; (ii) give one reason from Table 1: not applicable, legal prohibitions, confidentiality constraints, or information unavailable / incomplete, with the required explanation.

questions.text: Do you publish a GRI content index that includes: the title 'GRI content index'; the statement of use; the title of GRI 1 used; the title(s) of the applicable GRI Sector Standard(s); a list of your material topics; a list of Sector Standard topics determined not material with explanations; a list of reported disclosures with titles; the titles of the Standards and other sources they come from; for omitted Topic Standard disclosures listed in a Sector Standard, the disclosures and reasons for omission; the Sector Standard reference numbers; the location of the information for each disclosure; and any reasons for omission used?
questions.hint: Requirement 7-a (i to xii). Provide a link or reference to where the content index is published.

questions.text: If you publish a standalone sustainability report and the GRI content index is not included in the report itself, do you provide a link or reference to the GRI content index in the report?
Do you include the following statement in your GRI content index: '[Name of organization] has reported in accordance with the GRI Standards for the period [reporting period start and end dates]'?
questions.hint: Requirement 8-a. Insert the organization's name and the start and end dates of the reporting period.

questions.text: Have you notified GRI of your use of the GRI Standards and the statement of use by sending an email to reportregistration@globalreporting.org?
questions.hint: Requirement 9-a. Include the legal name, the link to the GRI content index, the link to the report if a standalone report is published, the statement of use, and a contact person.
